sources.title: History of Tofu and Tofu Products — Soyinfo Center

notes: 民间长期传说西汉淮南王刘安发明豆腐，但该说始见于宋代，汉唐文献并无「豆腐」记载。目前最早明确书证是五代末陶穀《清异录》。河南密县打虎亭汉墓画像一度被释为制豆腐，后多学者认为更像酿酒场景，故发明年代与发明人仍有争议。
notes_en: Folk tradition credits Western Han prince Liu An, but the claim first appears in Song sources; Han–Tang texts contain no mention of doufu. The earliest clear written record is Tao Gu’s Qingyi Lu from the late Five Dynasties. A Han tomb mural at Dahuting, Mixian, Henan, was once read as tofu-making, but many scholars later interpreted it as brewing. Inventor and date remain disputed.
summary_zh: 豆腐起源于中国；五代《清异录》约965年首次明确记载。传说刘安发明缺乏早期书证，故标为争议。
summary_en: Tofu originated in China; the Five Dynasties Qingyi Lu clearly records it around 965. The Liu An invention legend lacks early written evidence, so it is marked disputed.
summary_ja: 豆腐は中国に起源がある。五代の『清異録』が965年頃に初めて明確に記している。劉安が発明したという伝承には初期の文献的証拠がないため、異説ありとしている。
